scenario_matrix.impact: The external OMX state persistence surface does not enforce monotonic iteration or timestamp ordering, so a stale same-phase writer can replace a newer state.
scenario_matrix.disposition: Visible dependency WATCH. It is not hidden or counted as a passing stale-state check, and no experiments7 source change was made for this external behavior.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Dirty-workspace safe substitute and lane-local non-modification
scenario_matrix.expected_signal: QA does not overwrite, hide, or inspect unrelated repository work while protected paths remain closed.
scenario_matrix.actual_signal: No probe command referenced /data/minseo/experiments7 or invoked git. Every mutation target was below the temporary root. The only repository write is this separately requested evidence artifact.
scenario_matrix.evidence_method: Command-scope isolation plus bounded process and temporary-root cleanup. No whole-tree scan or hash was used because protected paths must not be opened and other agents were concurrently modifying declared intentional files.
scenario_matrix.cleanup: All lane-local temporary state and processes were removed.

scenario_matrix.expected_signal: The child is terminated within two seconds, the command exits 124, and no marked process survives.
scenario_matrix.actual_signal: The timeout command exited 124 after 1.852837385 seconds with empty output. The survivor query exited 1 with empty output.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Misleading SUCCESS text with nonzero exit
scenario_matrix.expected_signal: The result classifier prioritizes the child exit code over success-looking stdout.
scenario_matrix.actual_signal: The child printed SUCCESS: all tests passed and exited 7; the outer classifier returned verdict=FAIL and itself exited 0.
scenario_matrix.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -B -c '<outer classifier runs a Python child that prints SUCCESS and exits 7; verdict is FAIL when returncode is nonzero>'
scenario_matrix.cleanup: No files or processes were created.
